principles: Count physical submitted files with the multiplier required by the selected official formula.
Count each physical file independently even when two files have identical bytes.
Do not count an embedded component a second time; bind its offset, length, role, and SHA-256 within its counted container.
Count exact required option text as ASCII bytes.
Compute Gamma expanded closure separately from the official score.
Never infer build, inverse, determinism, resource, dependency, or license authority from package size.
A score below a threshold is a size statement, not submission authority.
